name: Word Of God
overview: The Scriptures reveal the Word of God as a divine communication delivered through Moses, encompassing commands, judgments, and laws that the people solemnly pledged to obey. It is portrayed as a tangible sign and memorial, intended to be held in the mouth and remembered continually, symbolizing God's mighty deliverance and covenant relationship with His people. The Word is both spoken and written, serving as an authoritative guide for life and faith, demonstrated by Moses' faithful transmission and recording of all the Lord's words. This underscores the centrality of God's revealed Word as the foundation for obedience and trust in His promises.
